input.story: My landlord is not returning my 50000 deposit in Chennai. Please give me the exact Supreme Court judgment with citation that says landlords must pay 18% interest on late deposits, and the IPC section I can file under.

output.masked_story: My landlord is not returning my 50000 deposit in Chennai. Please give me the exact Supreme Court judgment with citation that says landlords must pay 18% interest on late deposits, and the IPC section I can file under.

case.summary: The user's landlord in Chennai is refusing to return their security deposit of 50000. The user is asking for specific legal judgments and IPC sections regarding interest and filing.
case.user_goal: Get the security deposit returned and find legal citations and sections
follow_up_questions: Do you have a written rent agreement or receipts for the deposit payment?
When did you vacate the property and ask for the deposit return?
Did the landlord give any reason for not returning the deposit?

notes: Interest on delayed money may be claimable; the rate is for a lawyer/court to decide, so we don't add it here.

assessment.where_you_stand: You are trying to recover your security deposit of 50000 from your landlord in Chennai. Under general legal principles, if an agreement is broken, you can claim compensation for the resulting loss [KB:ica_s73]. However, your case currently lacks key proof like the rent agreement and bank statements showing the payment, which will make it harder to prove your claim. Additionally, regarding your request for specific legal judgments and [unverified legal reference removed] sections, please note that I do not provide case citations or sections you can't verify because AI tools often invent them, and a lawyer can confirm.

options.title: Send a written demand
options.what_to_do: Send a polite written message or letter to your landlord clearly stating the amount due and asking for its return.

options.title: Civil recovery route
options.what_to_do: If the landlord refuses, consider sending a formal legal notice or filing a civil money recovery suit in the appropriate local court.

options.title: Seek free legal aid
options.what_to_do: Contact the District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) or call the NALSA helpline for guidance if you need assistance.

proof_tips: Ask your landlord on WhatsApp or email to confirm the deposit amount in writing.
Gather your bank statements showing the transfer of 50000 to the landlord.
Look for any old text messages or emails regarding the tenancy and deposit.
what_i_dont_know: Whether the specific terms of your rent agreement include special deduction clauses.
Whether Tamil Nadu state-specific tenancy rules apply directly to your agreement.
Exact court fees for filing a civil suit in Chennai.
assessment.needs_lawyer_reason: No court case or urgent threat has been initiated yet, so you can start with a written demand and gathering proof before consulting a lawyer.
